nodes.speaker: Margaret
nodes.text: Two on the floor and one back there with the screens. Someone is expecting trouble, or someone's mother runs the security firm.

nodes.speaker: Margaret
nodes.text: Every Thursday for thirty years. This is the first Thursday with a queue and three guards.

nodes.speaker: Margaret
nodes.text: Five. I counted. Five of them. Remember that, if you're the remembering kind.

nodes.speaker: Margaret
nodes.text: Five came in. I counted twice. Whatever else is happening, it isn't five men alone.
